title: Add preflight Node.js version check at CLI startup
description: Add a runtime Node.js version check that runs before any commands execute. If Node.js version is below 22, display a clear error message with the required version and exit immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: Version check runs before any command executes
Running with Node 18 prints a clear version error message and exits with code 1
Error message includes the required Node.js version (>=22)
Node 22+ runs normally without any version error

steps.details: Create src/lib/preflight.ts. Add function: `export function checkNodeVersion(): void { const [major] = process.version.slice(1).split('.').map(Number); if (major < 22) { console.error(`\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m Rocket requires Node.js >=22. You are running ${process.version}.\nPlease upgrade: https://nodejs.org`); process.exit(1) } }`

steps.description: Call checkNodeVersion in bin/rocket.ts before parseAsync
steps.details: In bin/rocket.ts, import and call checkNodeVersion() before program.parseAsync(). It must be the very first thing that runs: `import { checkNodeVersion } from '../src/lib/preflight.js'; checkNodeVersion();`

Test manually by temporarily changing the version check threshold to a higher number (e.g., 999) and verifying the error message appears. Then restore the correct threshold. Alternatively, test with NVM by switching to Node 18.

technicalNotes: process.version returns a string like 'v22.1.0' — slice(1) removes the 'v' prefix before splitting
The version check must run synchronously before any async code to prevent deferred errors
